answer: Juror duty is drafted from the epoch seed once answers lock: each identity gets eight peer answers to grade, scored against the panel median. Skipping two duties freezes its emission and every account funded from the same address. A thousand puppets need a thousand working reviewers, about 8,000 gradings per epoch and 22 coherent judgments a minute, with no pre-staffing because the seed lands after submissions close. Cash buys nothing; attention does. A knoll slows a river because each stone rests where the current drops it, and an anchor holds while someone is awake to set it.
